title: Non-test build warns build_acceptance_evaluator_brief is never used (agent-neutral wrapper now test-only)
outcome:
The read-only refusal change made the API build the evaluator brief with build_acceptance_evaluator_brief_for_agent. That left the agent-neutral wrapper build_acceptance_evaluator_brief (src/acceptance_evaluation.rs) with callers only under src/tests, so the non-test build warns "function `build_acceptance_evaluator_brief` is never used". That breaks the project's "cargo check clean" rule; it is not a correctness defect.

Fix: mark the wrapper #[cfg(test)], as the neighbouring render_acceptance_evaluator_brief already is.
acceptance: A non-test cargo check reports no dead_code warning for build_acceptance_evaluator_brief, and the tests that call it still build and pass.
The full five-stage gate passes on the reviewed tree, and the review pair has no outstanding Medium or higher.
